criterion.gapWithVoice: A gap over 20 s between two ayat is skipped by the app (AyahTimeline.skipTarget, from 1 s after the end to 0.2 s before the next start). Where the audit hears sound in such a gap, the ayah before it ends at the end of that sound plus 0.3 s, as for Hassan Saleh's last ayat, so the gap drops under 20 s and nothing that is heard is skipped. Of the 13 sets prepared on 11 Nov 2026, only these two gaps were over 20 s with sound in them.

corrections.reason: two faint sounds (-45.8 and -47.0 dBFS, 830 ms in all) in a 20.8 s gap after the ayah; ending the ayah after them keeps the gap under 20 s so nothing heard is skipped
